cookies.009.en: We use Google Analytics, a service of Google, to count visits and see which pages are read, so that we can improve the site. It runs only if you choose Accept when the site asks, or later under Cookie settings at the foot of every page. Until then nothing is loaded from Google and no Google Analytics cookie is set; if you never answer, nothing is. If your browser sends Global Privacy Control or Do Not Track, the site does not ask and Google Analytics stays off.

cookies.014.en: Google receives the address of the page you open, with nothing after it (no search words or codes), the address of the site you came from, the time, your browser, kind of device, screen size and language, and an approximate location that Google works out from your IP address; Google Analytics does not log or store IP addresses. It also learns whether you scroll to near the end of a page, follow a link to another site, download a file, or play a YouTube video on the site.
